subject.title: fix(heartbeat): suppress Conversation info block for synthetic heartbeat turns

question: Should this PR be reworked to suppress heartbeat inbound metadata at the `runPreparedReply` caller boundary, or should maintainers consolidate the fix through the sibling caller-boundary PR?
rationale: Two open contributor PRs target the same source-proven bug, this one is conflicting and changes the generic metadata helper, and automation cannot safely choose the permanent owner boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require caller-boundary suppression

options.title: Accept the generic provider guard

options.body: Pause or close this branch after choosing the sibling caller-boundary branch as the canonical implementation and preserving useful contributor credit where appropriate.
